svg.title: Different controls produce different tempos
svg.desc: Use different state marks and progress lengths for pause, branch, resume and wait. Unequal tempos are the concept, not a uniform march forward. Visual distinction: A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction.
